name: WUI-NITY (Lund University)
description: Lund University wildfire-urban interface (WUI) evacuation simulation tool combining fire spread models with agent-based pedestrian and vehicle evacuation dynamics. Developed for NFPA Fire Protection Research Foundation to improve community evacuation planning in wildfire-prone areas. Integrates fire behavior with human response modeling.
domain: wildfire evacuation, emergency planning, fire safety engineering
general_score_metric: scenario_based (evacuation clearance time, percent evacuated, casualties)
reputation: recognized research tool in fire safety engineering and emergency planning communities
notes: Academic research tool developed with NFPA support. Combines FARSITE/Prometheus fire spread models with agent-based traffic and pedestrian evacuation. Open-source components available.
